spec.description: Detailed Engineering Analytics & SPC using only measured ldi_data. Symmetric two-column analysis, explicit units/axes, exact point drilldown, capability statistics, distributions, and full production-cycle records.

spec.title: temperature — 1-min AVG (22±2°C)
spec.description: Temperature per machine on the operational scale 18-28°C. Invalid zero sensor rows are monitored separately in Data Readiness.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT
  time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time,
  eqp_id AS metric,
  AVG(temperature) :: NUMERIC AS value
FROM
  public.ldi_data
WHERE
  factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
  AND process IN (${process:sqlstring})
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
  AND fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(time)
  AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring})
  AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring})
  AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
  AND temperature IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
  1,
  2
ORDER BY
  1

spec.title: pe_1–pe_6 / pe_setting — Cp & Cpk
spec.description: Calculated from real PE1-PE6 samples in the selected time, Factory, MO and Machine filters. Assumes symmetric +/- pe_setting limits.

spec.rawSql:
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, d.pe_setting, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring})
    AND d.layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring}) AND d.layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring}) AND d.log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL AND d.pe_setting IS NOT NULL
), stats AS (
  SELECT eqp_id, AVG(pe) AS mean_pe, STDDEV_SAMP(pe) AS stddev_pe, AVG(pe_setting) AS pe_limit
  FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id
), capability AS (
  SELECT *, pe_limit / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0) AS cp,
    LEAST((pe_limit - mean_pe) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0), (mean_pe + pe_limit) / NULLIF(3 * stddev_pe, 0)) AS cpk
  FROM stats
)
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine", ROUND(cp::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cp", ROUND(cpk::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cpk"
FROM capability ORDER BY cpk DESC NULLS LAST;

spec.title: pe_1–pe_6 — Standard Deviation
spec.description: Real PE1-PE6 standard deviation for the selected filters. Replaces the missing v_process_stability view.

spec.rawSql:
WITH pe_samples AS (
  SELECT d.eqp_id, p.pe
  FROM public.ldi_data d
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (d.pe_1),(d.pe_2),(d.pe_3),(d.pe_4),(d.pe_5),(d.pe_6)) p(pe)
  WHERE $__timeFilter(d."time")
    AND d.factory IN (${factory:sqlstring})
    AND d.process IN (${process:sqlstring})
    AND d.mo IN (${mo:sqlstring})
    AND d.fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring})
    AND d.layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring})
    AND d.eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring}) AND d.layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring}) AND d.log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring})
    AND p.pe IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT eqp_id AS "Machine", ROUND(STDDEV_SAMP(pe)::NUMERIC, 3) AS "StdDev"
FROM pe_samples GROUP BY eqp_id HAVING STDDEV_SAMP(pe) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY "StdDev" DESC;

spec.title: Production Cycle — Full ldi_data Records
spec.description: Detailed selected-cycle records. Click Time to open the exact Machine Snapshot record.

spec.rawSql:
SELECT time AS "Time", eqp_id AS "Machine", factory AS "Factory",
  mo AS "MO", fpn AS "Part", layer_name AS "Layer", board_no AS "Board", total_board AS "Total Boards", ROUND((total_time / NULLIF(total_board, 0))::NUMERIC, 3) AS "Cycle Time", CASE WHEN state THEN 'RUNNING' ELSE 'STOPPED' END AS "State", board_id AS "Board ID", log_id AS "Log ID" FROM public.ldi_data WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) AND process IN (${process:sqlstring}) AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) AND fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring}) AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring}) AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring}) AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring}) AND $__timeFilter(time) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 50

SELECT 
  time_bucket('1 minute', time) AS time, 
  eqp_id AS metric, 
  AVG(total_time)::NUMERIC AS value 
FROM public.ldi_data 
WHERE factory IN (${factory:sqlstring}) 
  AND process IN (${process:sqlstring}) 
  AND mo IN (${mo:sqlstring}) 
  AND fpn IN (${fpn:sqlstring}) 
  AND $__timeFilter(time) 
  AND eqp_id IN (${eqp_id:sqlstring}) 
  AND layer_name IN (${layer_name:sqlstring}) 
  AND log_id IN (${log_id:sqlstring}) 
  AND total_time > 0 
GROUP BY 1, 2 
ORDER BY 1

GROUP BY 1, 2 
ORDER BY 1
